boundary.en: 背 bèi is displayed first to make the author's a + back / back ↔ 背 comparison visible. The standard modern translation remains 吃惊地 in taken aback; no English–Chinese cognacy is claimed.
boundary.zh-Hans: 先展示“背”bèi，以突出作者的 a＋back／back↔背比较；现代 taken aback 的通用翻译仍是“吃惊地”，不主张英汉同源。

gloss.en: chiefly in taken aback: suddenly surprised or startled
gloss.zh-Hans: 主要用于 taken aback：突然吃惊、猝不及防

meaning.en: The standard modern sense is ‘suddenly surprised,’ chiefly in taken aback. The older spatial structure a + back (‘at/on the back; backward’) and the back ↔ 背 candidate are displayed separately.
meaning.zh-Hans: 现代通用义主要是 taken aback 中的“突然吃惊”；较早的空间结构 a＋back（在背后／向后）以及 back↔背候选另行展示。

proposition.en: Civilization is behind you, and you are its bearer.
proposition.zh-Hans: 文明在你的背后，而你是文明的载体。

text.en: People of the civilized world, who have moved from place to place from ancient times until today—you are the bearers of civilization; civilization stands behind you. Loving you has nothing to do with you. I want to do something for my people; that feeling is my own intention. Your arrival was, within the reach of my sight, something that ought to come. If you are the spark that kindled warmth across my earth, may we also say that the spark chose you as its bearer? I am a fruit nearing ripeness, bright and radiant beneath your sunlight.
text.zh-Hans: 那自古至今不断变换地方的，文明世界的人啊，你是文明的载体，文明在你的背后。爱你，与你无关；我想为我的人们做事，那种情感，是我自己的本意。你的来到，在我的眼界中，是你应该来临的。如果说你是我的火种，点燃了我的大地的温暖，那是否可以说，那火种以你为载体？我是那快要成熟的果啊，在你的阳光下，明媚灿烂。

evidence_boundary.en: Civilization, the spark, earth, fruit and sunlight are literary images; they are not evidence for etymology or cognacy.
evidence_boundary.zh-Hans: 文明、火种、大地、果实与阳光属于文学意象，不构成词源或同源证据。

source.raw_note: 英语：a- pref. 这里选择无意义这种说法；aback [ə'bæk] ad. 在背后；a.back；back [bæk] n. 背。法语：dos n. 背。汉语：背【bei】ad.。备注：作者以字母 a 的字母名称与“背”bèi 作读音联想。诗歌：《文明在你背后》，全文已收入文学层。
